source:
@@U00803@@
With worthy guests like you,
that would be taking things too far.
Very well, then.
Now. Hurry! What can I serve you?

@@U00805@@
Whatever you like!
Just don't waste time asking questions!

@@U00806@@
(After all the holes have bored and plugged.)

@@U00808@@
(With strange gestures.)

@@U00809@@
Wine grapes of the vine are born,
The billy-goat’s head sprouts a double horn;
The wine is juicy, the vines are wood,
The wooden table gives wine as good.
Here’s a truth for all that see;
Gaze into Nature’s mystery.
Now pull the stoppers and enjoy yourselves!

@@U00810@@
(As they draw the stoppers wine flows into each one’ glass.)

@@U00812@@
O lovely fountain that flows for us all!

@@U00814@@
Be careful you don’t spill a drop!

@@U00815@@
(They drink repeatedly.)

@@U00817@@
(Singing.)

@@U00818@@
Things are about as
Good as can be,
We're like a whole pack of
Pigs on a spree!

@@U00820@@
See that? How free they are?
They're lapping it up!
translation:
@@U00803@@
有像您这样尊贵的客人，
那就太过分了。
那么很好。
现在。匆忙！我能为您服务什么？

@@U00805@@
随你喜欢！
只是不要浪费时间问问题！

@@U00806@@
（所有孔都钻孔并堵塞后。）

@@U00808@@
（用奇怪的手势。）

@@U00809@@
葡萄树上的酿酒葡萄诞生了，
公山羊的头上长出双角；
酒是多汁的，藤蔓是木头的，
木桌提供的酒也同样好。
对于所有看到的人来说，这是一个真理；
凝视大自然的奥秘。
现在拉上塞子，尽情享受吧！

@@U00810@@
（当他们拉开塞子时，酒就会流入每个人的杯子里。）

@@U00812@@
啊，为我们所有人而流淌的可爱的喷泉！

@@U00814@@
小心别溅出一滴！

@@U00815@@
（他们反复喝酒。）

@@U00817@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00818@@
事情大约是这样的
尽可能好，
我们就像一整群
猪们疯狂狂欢！

@@U00820@@
看到了吗？他们有多自由？
他们正在舔舐它！
